svg.title: Finite-volume spin-channel splitting, mixing-conductance interface, and HM/FM spin-accumulation profile
svg.desc: Three-panel transport diagram showing (a) spin-channel voltage splitting V +/- mu_s/2 and additive face flux Q_i, (b) MixingConductanceSpinInterface separating longitudinal transmission and backflow (G_up, G_down) from full transverse absorption (G_r, G_i), and (c) FM spin-reaction vector triad (R_sf, R_J, R_phi) alongside the analytical 1D spatial spin-accumulation profile across the HM/FM interface.
